messages:
emily: Quick check — railline smoke is green for staging, but there's a failing flaky in unit-tests that blocks cut. CI shows failure in tests/payment/charge_retries.rb :frowning: Anyone on that area?
raj: I can take a look, which PR/commit?
emily: PR #4821 (release/0.21 -> main) — error starts after bundle bump. stack trace here:
```
Failure: test_retry_on_503 at tests/payment/charge_retries.rb:58
expected: 3 got: 1
```
marta: that's the flaky we've seen in canary yesterday, I put a debug patch but didn't push. I'll open a tiny fix and ping. ETA 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
deploy-bot: Canary deployment to us-west finished — 0 failures reported in 15m window. :white_check_mark: 
raj: if marta's patch is tiny can we fast-track it as a backport to 0.21.3? we should avoid cutting with broken tests.
emily: +1. If it's only a test change, we can backport and rerun cut pipeline.
nate: I can queue the re-run for the staging pipeline once marta opens the PR. remind me to set RERUN_REASON=flaky-fix.
ci-bot: Re-run queued by nate on pipeline #778 for commit abc123.
sre-oncall: Heads up — a spike in pod restarts hit infra-qa earlier but recovered. Not related to the release, just FYI.
emily: OK putting cut on hold until marta's PR lands and CI is all green. Will post another status in 45m.
marta: PR opened: #4829 — removes timing dependency in test, adds explicit wait. @raj can you review quick?
raj: Reviewing now. small nits, will approve after a tiny tweak.
emily: thanks. Once approved, nate please kick the staging run and I'll unhold the cut if green.
nate: will do.
emily: FYI, trying to keep cut window 2pm-4pm PT. If anything drags beyond 3:15pm we shift to tomorrow morning.
raj: ack.
ci-bot: Pipeline #778: all checks passed.
deploy-bot: Rollforward planned after approval window.
emily: Great — leaving thread open for final thumbs. :thumbsup:
